Tips

  1. Hover over any bar, data point, or line to see the exact date, industry name, and value.
  2. Single-click a legend entry to exclude that time series from a line chart; double-click a legend entry to isolate that one time series.

Construction Construction Private Services Private services-producing industries
Education & Health Educational services, health care, and social assistance Professional Services Professional and business services
Federal Federal Recreation & Food Arts, entertainment, recreation, accommodation, and food services

Financial Statement Translation

This deck uses financial-analyst terminology as the primary language throughout. Each term is an analytical analogue to a BEA industry-account concept. The useful part is the structure, not a claim of accounting equivalence.

Presentation Term BEA Industry-Account Concept
Revenue Gross Output
COGS Intermediate Inputs
Gross Profit Gross Value Added
Gross Margin Gross Value Added divided by Gross Output
EBITDA Gross Operating Surplus
EBITDA Margin Gross Operating Surplus / Gross Output

Revenue = COGS + Gross Profit
